minutes.headline: Open Space approved September minutes; tabled farmland-of-local-importance request and Townsend Harbor Road parcel.
minutes.summary: The committee regained a quorum after missing October through December and approved the September 11 minutes by roll call. It discussed an NRCS effort to list Farmland of Local Importance and a Chapter 61 parcel on Townsend Harbor Road, and tabled both. The next meetings were set for February 12 and March 12 on Zoom.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the September 11 meeting.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the Conservation Commission received a state award last year and wondered whether it could be used to protect land. It was noted this is not a budget item and the committee is separate.
A member said the design work is meant to produce a number for annual town meeting, and that the board is trying to stay under a ceiling. No hard numbers yet.

decisions.decision: Farmland of Local Importance request tabled until next month's meeting; no action requested yet.
Townsend Harbor Road parcel (Chapter 61 right of first refusal) tabled; no recommendation made, as members saw it not meeting criteria.
Glenn to follow up at the planning board on streamlining notification of such parcels; chair to check with Mary on conservation's view.
Next meetings set for February 12 and March 12 at 7:30 on Zoom; in-person meetings to be considered from April.

what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee tabled the request to list Farmland of Local Importance until its next monthly meeting, with no action requested yet.
The committee tabled a Chapter 61 right-of-first-refusal parcel on Townsend Harbor Road and made no recommendation, as members saw it as not meeting criteria.
A member is to raise streamlining notification of such parcels at the planning board, and the chair is to check the conservation commission's view.
The September minutes were approved by roll call once a quorum was regained after missing October through December.
The next meetings were set for February 12 and March 12 at 7:30 on Zoom, with in-person meetings to be considered from April.

why_it_matters: A Chapter 61 parcel gives the town a short window to use its right of first refusal, so tabling a case and the notification problems discussed can affect whether farmland or open land is considered in time.
No money was voted on; Town Hall design funding and a Conservation Commission state award came up only as comments, and no figures were given.
